units.acceptanceCriteria: A real complex animated Maya fixture preserves its expected clips, feather or attachment motion and supported material appearance. Artist-provided FBX remains useful independently but does not satisfy native MA/MB acceptance. Missing plugins or licenses produce explicit dependency failures.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement MA/MB conversion through provisioned version-qualified Maya workers. Evaluate supported rig constraints and expressions, bake named clips and deformation, resolve dependencies, and export tested exchange/runtime outputs. Integrate shared baking and diagnostics while retaining original scenes and documented source-renderer requirements.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare native sampled poses and reference renders with converted clips; test multiple takes, source-version mismatch, missing plugins and worker interruption.
sourceMetadata.security: Constrain native script evaluation inside disposable workers without secrets or arbitrary external access.

units.title: Qualified native 3ds Max scene connector
externalPrerequisites: Provisioned supported 3ds Max platform, required renderer/plugins and deployment rights; real MAX files and native runs required.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A real architectural MAX scene becomes a correctly scaled, grouped runtime venue with verified materials and openings. Legacy .3ds or seller-provided OBJ/DAE conversion does not falsely complete native MAX support. Unsupported plugin evaluation remains an explicit technical result.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement native .max conversion through a provisioned supported 3ds Max worker and qualified exporter. Resolve scene dependencies, supported modifiers and instances; bake supported renderer materials and export documented runtime features. Record exact source/application/plugin versions and preserve originals.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare source views, instance transforms, material assignments and modifier output; exercise missing renderer, unsupported file version, cancellation and native application crashes.
sourceMetadata.security: Isolate native scene evaluation, restrict file/network access and validate generated resources before publication.

units.title: Qualified native Cinema 4D connector
externalPrerequisites: Provisioned Cinema 4D application/SDK and necessary plugins with supported deployment rights; real native runs required.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Real C4D fixtures produce matching supported geometry and animation through the deployed toolchain. Generic parser success or exchange-file conversion cannot establish native C4D completion. Missing renderers, generators or unsupported versions produce identified diagnostics.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement a Cinema 4D connector through a provisioned supported native application or SDK route. Qualify generators, instance hierarchies, materials, animation and dependency resolution before claiming each feature. Feed evaluated results into the shared compiler and export registry, preserving original scene data.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run native instances, generator evaluation, animated transforms, material references and missing-plugin cases; compare source views and output pose samples.
sourceMetadata.security: Run native evaluation with bounded privileges, resources and dependency access; verify output integrity before publishing.

units.title: CAD and BIM tessellation with retained metadata
externalPrerequisites: Representative CAD/BIM source files and reference outputs; specialist binary builds must be qualified on deployment workers.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Reference CAD assemblies and IFC buildings import at correct scale with selectable component identity and usable derived traversal. Changing tessellation tolerances creates new derivatives without changing originals. Export states precisely which metadata and geometry representations survive.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add specialist STEP/IGES and IFC adapters using qualified OCCT and IfcOpenShell builds. Tessellate supported surfaces/solids with configurable tolerances while retaining assemblies, units, object identifiers and useful BIM properties. Preserve construction sources and document semantics that runtime meshes cannot express.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare bounds, tolerances, assembly transforms, IFC identifiers and property mappings against native references; test complex surfaces, absent units and unsupported entity types.
sourceMetadata.security: Bound tessellation complexity, schema expansion and metadata payloads; isolate parsers and inventory actual dependency licenses.

units.title: Alembic and bounded simulation-cache playback
externalPrerequisites: Representative native cache sequences and reference samples are needed to qualify each advertised cache feature.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Qualified cache sequences play, seek, loop and restore after world export/reimport with their intended timing. Unsupported topology or storage requirements produce actionable results. Cache loading remains incremental and respects declared memory budgets.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement an Alembic/cache adapter with explicit support for constant-topology deformation and a bounded changing-topology sequence route. Preserve source timing and dependency data; supply runtime playback and bundle serialization without mislabeling every cache as skeletal glTF. Define independent static or authored collision representations.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare sampled vertices and frame timing with source references; exercise sparse frames, topology changes, seeking, interrupted loading, loop seams and bundle round trips.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce decompressed-frame, sequence-duration, memory and decoder-time budgets; isolate archive/cache parsers.

units.title: Point-cloud and Gaussian-splat streaming adapters
externalPrerequisites: Selected renderer-adapter support and representative scan datasets must pass actual browser/device qualification.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Representative scans stream at the selected device profile, retain scale and placement, and round-trip through complete world export. Visual splats are never treated automatically as solid meshes. Unsupported splat schemas are identified before placement.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement specialized point-cloud and Gaussian-splat adapters with explicit schema detection, spatial streaming, picking and renderer integration. Preserve originals and component metadata; generate or attach separately qualified collision/traversal surfaces. Store adapter state and dependencies in world bundles and expose honest edit/export capabilities.
sourceMetadata.tests: Measure memory and frame timing, compare representative views, test point/splat classification, picking, cell transitions, collider alignment and bundle reconstruction.
sourceMetadata.security: Bound point counts, attribute sizes and GPU allocations; validate custom attributes and isolate specialized decoding.

units.title: Complete asset coverage and representative venue acceptance
externalPrerequisites: Obtain representative source and runtime assets directly or by commission; native tools and required reference hardware must be available.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every advertised native connector has passed real provisioned-toolchain conversion, and every format has meaningful feature and failure evidence. Venue openings, clips, materials and editable round trips pass; incomplete native dependencies remain visibly incomplete rather than credited to exchange workarounds.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Publish the complete format/version/feature matrix and reproducible qualification corpus. Run the full intake, conversion, edit, optimization, physics and export workflow on substantial architecture and complex animated wildlife. Include direct-artist source/runtime deliverables, foreign-engine exchange exports, reference views and machine-readable results.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run corpus regression, cold/warm cache paths, corrupt dependencies, retry/cancel recovery and representative-device resource measurements against pinned builds.
sourceMetadata.security: Perform malicious-import and cross-tenant export probes against the integrated pipeline and verify source preservation after failures.

units.title: Implement authenticated remote URL import and fetch brokerage
units.acceptanceCriteria: An authorized user imports a permitted remote model or media file through the same publication workflow as an upload. Invalid destinations, redirects or failed downloads cannot create a misleading published asset or expose internal services.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement authenticated remote-source submission and a tenant-scoped fetch broker. Identify formats, preserve retrieved originals and provenance, and hand successful downloads to the existing asset/media preparation pipeline. Support bounded streaming downloads, cancellation, retries and actionable failure states.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run real permitted fetches plus private-address, DNS-change, redirect-chain, oversized-body, timeout and interrupted-transfer cases; verify source preservation, idempotency and cleanup.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize destination and tenant scope, revalidate DNS and every redirect, bind connections to validated addresses, restrict private/internal destinations and egress, strip unrelated credentials and enforce size/time limits.

units.title: Define versioned world networking contracts and adapters
units.acceptanceCriteria: An engine client negotiates a compatible protocol, joins a fixture room and exchanges typed state without conference imports. Unsupported versions fail with an actionable upgrade result. Commands and disposable poses have distinct documented delivery requirements.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Publish application-neutral contracts for room joins, input commands, acknowledgments, snapshots, transient poses, simulation clocks and connection lifecycle. Define message versions, entity identifiers, sequence numbers, idempotency keys and compatibility negotiation. Implement the selected networking adapter behind those contracts, with local and deterministic fixture transports for development.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise valid and malformed wire fixtures, version negotiation, duplicate commands, stale sequences and adapter teardown; retain compatibility fixtures for future releases.
sourceMetadata.security: Bound decoded sizes and collection lengths before allocation. Treat client identifiers, timestamps and requested operations as untrusted input.

units.title: Implement authenticated authoritative room membership
units.acceptanceCriteria: Two generic applications can join authorized worlds through the same API. Expired, revoked, wrong-instance and wrong-tenant grants fail. Rejoining retains the intended principal identity while duplicate active sessions follow an explicit policy.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement Colyseus-backed room creation, join, leave and lifecycle APIs using the foundation choice. Bind each room to an immutable world revision and tenant. Exchange host-application authorization for short-lived engine grants, then maintain server-verified membership, capabilities, participant identity and connection status without embedding conference roles.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run multi-tenant integration cases covering grant renewal, disconnect, duplicate identity, incompatible world revision, denied join and clean room disposal.
sourceMetadata.security: Recheck capabilities on protected operations; a successful join is not permission to edit, publish media or administer the room. Keep service credentials server-side.

units.title: Run the world through a fixed-step authoritative simulation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Multiple clients observe one authoritative object state, floor and wall layout. Client quality settings do not change collision. Unauthorized teleports, excessive command rates and attempts to create unbounded bodies are rejected predictably.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect room lifecycle to the renderer-independent physics runtime and a bounded fixed-step input queue. Separate simulation frequency, publication rate and client rendering. Validate movement and interactions against authoritative collision, apply explicit limits to dynamic entities, and expose snapshots without writing every tick into persistent authoring history.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run shared collision fixtures at configured tick rates; inject delayed inputs, overloaded ticks and invalid movement while measuring tick headroom and queue limits.
sourceMetadata.security: Treat client transforms as requests. Validate magnitude, finite numbers, world bounds and capabilities before modifying the physics state.

units.title: Add client prediction, reconciliation and remote interpolation
units.acceptanceCriteria: Local movement responds immediately while server corrections converge. Remote avatars move smoothly through publication gaps. Crossing a wall cannot become permanent through prediction, and correction never forcibly replaces the headset's real tracked pose.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate qualified Colyseus prediction and reconciliation primitives with the shared movement simulation. Buffer and acknowledge inputs, replay unacknowledged movement after authoritative corrections, and interpolate remote entity poses. Keep actual headset tracking local while reconciling the avatar body and validated locomotion; publish measurable correction and interpolation diagnostics.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise latency, jitter, reordered snapshots, reconnect and correction under the qualified browser/runtime versions; measure error without assuming cross-platform bitwise physics determinism.
sourceMetadata.security: Server validation remains authoritative regardless of prediction. Bound retained input history, reconciliation work and accepted client clock skew.

units.title: Arbitrate object interactions through expiring control leases
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only one authorized holder controls a contested object. Disconnect, expiry, deletion and authority changes release or invalidate ownership. An explicit save can later persist selected transforms; routine object movement does not modify the reusable world template.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement a reusable server-owned lease primitive and apply it to grab, carry, release, throw and interaction commands. Bind leases to principal, entity, operation, expiry and authority epoch. Resolve simultaneous requests deterministically, validate ongoing movement, and emit interaction results that clients can predict and reconcile.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise competing grabs, stale holder commands, lease renewal races, disconnect while carrying, excessive throws and entity deletion during an interaction.
sourceMetadata.security: Check capability, reach, allowed velocity and object constraints server-side. Never accept possession merely because the client renders an object as selected.

units.title: Bound network traffic and protect reliable commands
units.acceptanceCriteria: A slow client cannot accumulate unlimited memory. Release commands outrank unsent decorative updates; transport head-of-line delay remains measured. Queue overflow follows explicit degradation and reconnect rules, and pose publication can slow independently of simulation and rendering.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add separate outbound scheduling for acknowledged commands, essential state and replaceable poses. Begin with secure WebSockets: coalesce superseded poses before sending, bound all queues, apply backpressure and prioritize control traffic. Expose byte, queue-age and drop metrics; keep a transport extension point without claiming WebSocket frames are unreliable datagrams.
sourceMetadata.tests: Throttle links, suspend receivers, flood decorative changes and resume traffic; verify memory bounds, command acknowledgments, coalescing and stale-update rejection.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce per-principal message and byte limits, bounded parsing and fair scheduling. Disconnect abusive senders without starving unrelated room members.

units.title: Add spatial relevance and per-client state filtering
units.acceptanceCriteria: Crossing a relevance boundary adds and removes entities without flicker or stale ghosts. Nearby interactions retain required fidelity, while distant traffic decreases. Private entities remain absent from unauthorized state even when geometrically close.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Maintain a spatial index and explicit relevance tiers for avatars, props and transient events. Use qualified Colyseus per-client filtering for bounded state sets, reduce distant pose detail and expose authorized proximity signals to media adapters. Send immutable assets through manifests and storage rather than frequent room patches.
sourceMetadata.tests: Move clients through dense cells, teleports and rapidly changing visibility; measure filtering CPU, serialization time, payload size and transition correctness with realistic avatar data.
sourceMetadata.security: Intersect relevance with permissions before serialization. Distance and visibility are optimization inputs, never authorization. Bound per-client tracked sets and transition work.

units.title: Route rooms to fenced owners across a worker fleet
externalPrerequisites: A qualified coordination service with the required Redis protocol behavior and a deployment path that can route connections to room owners.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A join reaches its current owner behind a nonsticky load balancer. Fenced workers cannot commit as concurrent authorities. Adding workers increases room capacity without claiming that one room spans unlimited processes.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement room placement, owner discovery and routing to the process that hosts each room. Add owner leases with monotonically changing epochs, admission based on measured capacity profiles, and drain-aware placement. Qualify the selected Redis-compatible coordination implementation, including Valkey only after testing the exact commands, scripts, TTLs and failover behavior used.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise owner contention, expired leases, coordinator restart, TLS, script compatibility, network partitions and randomized reconnect routing in a multi-worker harness.
sourceMetadata.security: Authenticate coordination and worker traffic; validate routing grants and epochs. Prevent clients from selecting an unauthorized internal worker or tenant.

units.title: Recover rooms through checkpoints and controlled reconnects
units.acceptanceCriteria: A crashed room restores to a declared checkpoint and clients converge on its new authority. Stale leases and duplicate commands cannot replay ownership or saved edits. Planned deployment drains stop new admissions and guide existing clients through recovery.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Persist versioned checkpoints of recoverable transient state, world revision references and command progress. Implement reconnect negotiation, checkpoint restoration, owner-epoch changes and planned drain handoff. Distinguish durable edits from recoverable motion and document potential checkpoint loss; use controlled reconnects until uninterrupted migration is actually demonstrated.
sourceMetadata.tests: Kill workers during grabs and checkpoints, corrupt a snapshot, retry commands and roll service versions forward/back within the supported compatibility window.
sourceMetadata.security: Reauthorize returning principals and validate checkpoint provenance. Do not restore expired credentials or persist unnecessary detailed head/hand tracking history.

units.title: Provide authenticated Yjs collaboration and persistence
units.acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent edits converge after disconnect and reload. A document can be shared across authorized instances without leaking into another tenant. Read-only members cannot submit persisted changes, and transient cursor awareness does not become permanent tracking history.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Create an application-neutral Yjs provider for notes, whiteboards and annotations with document-scoped authorization, persistence, bounded updates and ephemeral awareness. Separate document identity from room identity so explicitly permitted documents can survive sessions. Define an opaque encrypted-update transport extension without treating Yjs as the authority for physics or presenter control.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise concurrent edits, compaction/reload, reconnect, oversized updates, revocation, denied document IDs and persistence failure with recovery.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize every document subscription and write. Limit update size and processing cost; sanitize rendered content separately from CRDT convergence.

units.title: Add scoped chat and ephemeral collaboration channels
units.acceptanceCriteria: Authorized members can exchange messages across reconnects without duplicates. Membership changes stop future delivery, and ephemeral signals expire. Applications select retention and deletion policies through engine APIs rather than modifying the transport implementation.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide generic room, group and direct-participant message channels with server-assigned ordering, idempotent sends, pagination and configurable retention. Add bounded ephemeral channels for reactions, pointers and presence. Expose moderation capabilities and lifecycle events for applications without implementing event roles, agendas or a conference-specific moderation interface.
sourceMetadata.tests: Verify ordering, repeated sends, private group transitions, deletion, pagination, denied recipients, rate limiting and reconnect after missed traffic.
sourceMetadata.security: Check channel membership on send and receive. Render untrusted text safely, bound attachments, and prevent user-controlled identifiers from crossing tenant boundaries.

units.title: Qualify networking under realistic load and failure
externalPrerequisites: Representative load hosts and target network profiles sized to the proposed qualification scenarios.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A standalone networking qualification harness works without conference services; W21 separately verifies the packaged game examples. Load and fault results identify the supported interaction profile, software versions and hardware. Rooms recover without split authority, unbounded queues or cross-tenant delivery.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Build repeatable multi-client and multi-room qualification scenarios with representative avatar poses, dynamic objects, interactions and collaborative edits. Exercise proposed 20, 50 and 100 participant profiles while measuring owner CPU, tick headroom, serialization, bandwidth, memory and recovery. Publish passing configurations and limits rather than a universal participant claim.
sourceMetadata.tests: Combine network impairment, worker/coordinator failures, rolling upgrades, competing grabs and document traffic; retain traces and reproducible fixture commands as release evidence.
sourceMetadata.security: Include hostile message rates, forged grants and relevance-boundary access attempts. Use synthetic principals and exclude private content from diagnostic traces.

units.title: Coordinate revocation and generic moderation across services
units.acceptanceCriteria: Removal stops protected activity and future media delivery across active connections and reconnects. Host applications define role policy while the engine enforces scoped actions; partial service failure has a documented fail-closed path.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement engine operations for removing principals, restricting publication/editing, expiring bans and invalidating control leases across world, media and collaboration services. Publish idempotent revocation events with measurable enforcement latency. Persist membership/revocation events and consumer acknowledgments. Apply them to collaboration writes/subscriptions, durable editing, presenter leases and device eligibility for future key envelopes; M16 consumes the same event lifecycle.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise revocation races, unavailable consumers, stale grants, repeat commands, ban expiry and attempts to retain an active presenter or grab lease. Verify one removal across world commands, documents, editing, presenter/grab leases, media admission and key-envelope eligibility.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize the moderator and target scope, retain safe audit records and prevent cross-tenant removal or silent access restoration after recovery.

units.title: Implement durable world revisions and authoring transactions
units.acceptanceCriteria: Two authorized clients can commit disjoint changes and receive explicit conflicts on incompatible edits. Undo creates a valid compensating revision. A published world references a consistent immutable dependency set.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement the server APIs for world templates, revisioned entity changes, idempotent command groups, history queries, optimistic conflicts and explicit snapshot publication. Keep these generic APIs independent of the browser editor and live physics ticks.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run database integration tests for concurrent commits, retries, interrupted transactions, migration, history visibility and snapshot restoration.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate principal, tenant, entity and dependency read permissions; audit changes without recording transient participant tracking or embedding credentials in world data.

units.title: Establish the shared spatial-audio graph and listener contract
units.acceptanceCriteria: A world source routes through exactly one spatial path. Entering or leaving XR switches the listener without duplicate audio or one listener per eye. World video defaults to spatial playback; global amplification requires an explicit configuration.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define serializable AudioEmitter and AudioZone components plus source adapters for buffers, media elements and live tracks. Build the Babylon AudioEngine v2/Web Audio integration with one local listener, category buses and explicit nonspatial modes. Bind listener position/orientation to desktop camera or XR head pose using canonical meters and coordinates.
sourceMetadata.tests: Verify coordinate fixtures, head rotation, camera changes, graph ownership, source disposal and serialization round trips using deterministic audio probes.
sourceMetadata.security: Source references resolve through authorized engine assets or tracks. Do not allow imported scene data to execute arbitrary audio-processing scripts.

units.title: Implement attached sounds, distance curves and continuous music mixing
units.acceptanceCriteria: Four distinct calibrated corner tracks remain continuously mixed with equal attenuation at equal distance; approaching a corner changes the balance smoothly. A bird's source follows its transform. Inverse falloff still reaches zero at the engine's configured cutoff.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add reusable short-sound buffers, streaming loops and entity/local-offset attachments. Implement configured attenuation, reference distance, rolloff, directional cones and a separate fade-start/audible-radius envelope. Preserve explicit mono/stereo handling and support calibration metadata. Attach sources to interpolated transforms so animated birds and moving objects carry their sounds smoothly.
sourceMetadata.tests: Measure gain and channel behavior with fixtures; exercise loops, changing distance, replacement, moving attachments and HRTF/equal-power profiles.
sourceMetadata.security: Bound decoding and cached buffers by published asset limits. Reject nonfinite gains or malformed distance settings before constructing audio nodes.

units.title: Add area emitters, acoustic zones and bounded occlusion
units.acceptanceCriteria: A waterfall grows louder near its authored extent rather than only near its center. Crossing zone boundaries remains smooth. Multiple emitters do not accidentally multiply the source level, and geometric walls influence the configured approximation without claiming full acoustic simulation.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement authored point, line and area-source approximations for waterfalls and broad sound features. Add optional acoustic zones, bounded collision-query occlusion, smooth low-pass/gain changes and modest reverb sends. Publish editable parameters and serialization hooks while keeping all sources within one coherent gain and phase model.
sourceMetadata.tests: Check area edges, moving listener paths, zone overlaps, normalized multi-emitter output and query budgets; compare occluded and unobstructed fixtures.
sourceMetadata.security: Acoustic attenuation never grants privacy. Bound emitter counts, impulse-response resources and per-frame geometry queries for creator-authored zones.

units.title: Manage audio activation, mixing controls and resource budgets
units.acceptanceCriteria: Join activation works within browser permissions. Headset sleep and tab suspension recover without duplicate nodes. Resource pressure preserves prioritized voice and presentations, while any quality downgrade retains distance behavior and avoids nearest-source switching among audible corner tracks.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement gesture-based audio unlock, suspension/resume handling and per-user voice, video, music, ambience and effects controls with master headroom. Budget active decoders and panners independently of graphics. Virtualize inaudible loops with hysteresis and preserved timeline, and expose a listener policy for applications using an accessible 2D view.
sourceMetadata.tests: Stress declared source budgets; cycle suspension, resume, scene reload and user mute; measure node/decoder cleanup and preserved loop positions.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce source limits even for trusted-looking manifests. Device and autoplay restrictions produce actionable state, never hidden attempts to bypass user permissions.

units.title: Introduce the LiveKit media adapter behind engine contracts
externalPrerequisites: A reachable LiveKit-compatible media service for integration testing; M07 supplies the self-hosted qualification environment.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A generic engine sample publishes and receives media through the adapter without importing a meeting application. Switching endpoint configuration preserves object bindings. Reconnect and track replacement have explicit events that downstream spatial systems can consume.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define media-session, publication, subscription and track-lifecycle interfaces independent of conference UI and world object semantics. Implement the selected LiveKit client/server adapter with stable source identities, connection state, mute/replacement events and service-side token issuance. Support both configured self-hosted and managed endpoints through the same public contract.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run adapter contract cases for join, publish, mute, replace, disconnect, reconnect and disposal; verify server/client version compatibility.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep API secrets server-side. Bind issued media identities to verified engine principals and fail closed on unsupported or unauthorized publication requests.

units.title: Enforce private media membership and subscription permissions
units.acceptanceCriteria: A modified client cannot subscribe to an unauthorized nearby microphone, private group or tenant. Membership removal stops future delivery through the tested service path. Applications choose group policy while the engine enforces identities, scopes and operations. Original and server-refreshed cached tokens cannot restore removed permissions. Measure the maximum enforcement interval, including control-plane partitions, and keep the claim blocked until the configured enforcement mechanism passes.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Map engine capabilities to narrow media-room, publication and subscription grants. Implement server-enforced private conversation membership, source permissions, renewal and revocation. Use separate authorized media rooms or verified server-side subscription enforcement where required; do not rely on client muting or a cooperative publisher to protect private streams. Implement a qualified self-hosted admission/revocation path at every signaling entry and reconnect, with membership epochs, no direct bypass and enforceable media-node checks for active-session access. Use a maintained server integration where needed; short token TTL alone is insufficient. Expiring authorization leases must bound active-session access when the control plane is unavailable.
sourceMetadata.tests: Attempt direct SDK subscriptions, forged track IDs, reused grants, stale membership and cross-room access; test revocation during playback and reconnect. Reuse original/refreshed tokens after removal, attempt direct signaling access and interrupt management/control services during active media; verify bounded termination without granting stale access.
sourceMetadata.security: Acoustic range and AOI are independent of permission. Document grant lifetime and revocation latency; never expose service administrator credentials to browsers.

units.title: Ship a self-hosted SFU and TURN deployment harness
externalPrerequisites: UDP-capable test hosts with routable public addresses, DNS/TLS certificates and controlled external clients; generic HTTP-only hosting is insufficient.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Two external clients communicate through direct connectivity and forced TURN fallback. Multiple rooms distribute across the media fleet, while one room's capacity remains measured. Planned node drain and failure produce documented reconnect behavior and actionable diagnostics.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide pinned LiveKit and TURN configurations, local integration orchestration and a reference production deployment with explicit UDP/TCP ports, TLS, public addressing and health checks. Qualify coordination compatibility and node draining. Document the single-node room boundary, region placement and which hosting services can expose the required media networking.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise restricted networks, UDP blocking, TCP/TLS fallback, certificate renewal, coordinator interruption and media-node restart using external probes.
sourceMetadata.security: Use authenticated expiring TURN credentials, restricted administration and secrets injection. Prevent the relay from becoming an unauthenticated public service. Expose signaling only through the qualified admission path and deploy the M06 media-node revocation/lease enforcement configuration.

units.title: Attach remote microphones to avatars without duplicate playback
units.acceptanceCriteria: Walking avatars carry their voices; listener motion and head rotation change the mix appropriately. Muting, reconnecting or replacing a microphone never creates two playback paths. Missing avatars use an explicit temporary binding policy rather than silently becoming global audio.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Wrap each selected incoming microphone track in a single-track media-stream audio source and bind it to the avatar's interpolated head/mouth offset. Reconcile track identity, mute, replacement and teardown with the media adapter. Publish local microphone capture outbound without default local monitoring or a simultaneous global conference audio renderer.
sourceMetadata.tests: Use two moving clients to check spatial gain, track replacement, mute, late avatar arrival, device permission denial and clean disposal.
sourceMetadata.security: Create nodes only for authorized subscribed tracks. Revocation tears down playback promptly; local capture starts only after the browser's permission flow.

units.title: Create generic media surfaces and an extensible viewer registry
units.acceptanceCriteria: Images, registered content and unknown attachments can be placed, replaced, moved and deleted without orphaned resources. Unsupported files receive a clear attachment/preview result. A surface exports and reimports with stable source and audio references.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement media-surface entities with source revision, aspect ratio, audio binding, preview state and disposal lifecycle. Add a registry for authorized viewers/converters and an attachment fallback that preserves originals. Expose the same content through world surfaces and accessible 2D views without assuming arbitrary websites, native applications or file formats render inside VR. Resolve imported external file sources through the A25 broker and preserve their publication identity.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise registry selection, unsupported types, missing revisions, loading failures, replacement, lifecycle cleanup and serialization.
sourceMetadata.security: Treat viewer plugins as trusted engine extensions. Resolve files through authorized storage and validate external fetches; never execute embedded active content automatically.

units.title: Publish camera and screen capture onto world surfaces
externalPrerequisites: Actual supported desktop browsers and headset receivers; available capture-audio sources vary by browser and operating system.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A desktop user chooses the capture source through the browser prompt. Headsets display supported incoming streams regardless of their ability to originate capture. Stop-sharing, source termination and replacement update both picture and spatial sound.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add explicit camera and desktop screen-capture workflows, publication controls and live textures. Associate captured audio with the intended screen/camera emitter without duplicating microphone playback. Provide a short-lived paired-device presentation capability so a desktop can originate a stream while a headset receives it; keep application presenter policy outside the engine.
sourceMetadata.tests: Qualify capture denial, window/tab/system-audio variations, ended tracks, paired-device expiry and mixed microphone/screen audio on supported browsers.
sourceMetadata.security: Require user activation and scoped publication grants. Pairing must bind verified principals and require explicit device confirmation; never silently capture another device.

units.title: Play uploaded video through one synchronized visual/audio element
units.acceptanceCriteria: A looping wall video sounds as if it comes from its screen, including after movement or replacement. Pausing and seeking affect picture and sound together. Muting its emitter removes that video's audio completely, with no independent global route.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Load qualified uploaded-video variants into one media element used by both the video texture and MediaElementAudioSourceNode. Connect its audio once to the screen emitter, expose play/pause/seek/loop controls and preserve source clock ownership. Handle authorized CDN access, CORS, codec selection and clear failure states.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise loops, seeks, resize, disposal, unsupported codecs, expired URLs and CORS failures while measuring audio/video alignment.
sourceMetadata.security: Use published validated variants and authorized delivery. Reject arbitrary decoder inputs beyond resource limits and avoid exposing signed media URLs in logs.

units.title: Synchronize presentation control and media playback across clients
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only the current authorized controller changes a surface. Late joiners reach the current page or video position, and lease expiry or handoff cannot replay stale controls. Each client shares playback state while retaining its own spatial audio mix.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Apply server-owned presentation leases to source selection, page changes and video controls. Synchronize asset revision, source identity, sequence number, play state, position, rate and server-time anchor. Implement late-join reconstruction and measured drift correction; keep transient pointers separate from durable content and application-specific presenter selection. Register checkpoint/restore hooks for source revision, page, playback time anchor and controller epoch with N09; invalidate stale presenter leases after authority-owner changes.
sourceMetadata.tests: Inject clock offset, delayed controls, duplicate seeks, simultaneous handoff, late join and buffering; measure drift and sequence convergence. Crash the world owner during active video and presenter handoff, restore the checkpoint and verify late-join reconstruction with a new authority epoch.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate every control operation against entity scope and lease epoch. Source changes must reference authorized published content, not unchecked external URLs.

units.title: Allocate media subscriptions from world visibility and audio relevance
units.acceptanceCriteria: A visible video texture does not stop because its backing element is hidden. Crossing a voice range avoids rapid subscription churn and clipped initial speech under the qualified margin. Revoked streams are removed regardless of retention margins or priority.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Drive stream subscription and quality from projected surface size, visibility, priority and decoder budgets rather than hidden HTML-element dimensions alone. Add authorized voice pre-subscription margins, smooth fades and hysteresis around audible boundaries. Prioritize active presentations and speech while exposing policy hooks for applications and device profiles.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise occluded screens, moving listeners, rapid viewport changes, constrained decoder counts, competing streams and permission changes while measuring quality transitions.
sourceMetadata.security: Intersect every optimization decision with server authorization. Client proximity requests cannot widen private media membership or bypass source permissions.

units.title: Render PDF slides, images and readable text surfaces
externalPrerequisites: The qualified office-conversion and font environment supplied by the document-conversion lane.
units.acceptanceCriteria: A presenter changes a slide once and authorized clients display the same page revision in desktop and immersive views. Nearby text remains readable within the qualified device budget. Users can access original files and choose screen sharing when static conversion loses essential behavior.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate PDF.js page rendering, image panels and text surfaces with bounded resolution, lazy page loading and accessible 2D text/navigation. Consume immutable office-to-PDF outputs and publish page metadata to presentation synchronization. Preserve original documents and show conversion limitations, including unsupported animations, fonts or embedded applications.
sourceMetadata.tests: Use large-page, font, rotation, image and malformed-document fixtures; verify page identity, accessibility, resource limits and late joins.
sourceMetadata.security: Disable automatic execution or navigation from document actions. Resolve external references through approved policies and isolate conversion outside the browser runtime.

units.title: Connect shared notes, whiteboards and page annotations to surfaces
units.acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent notes and strokes converge after reconnect. Page changes keep annotations on their correct page and source revision. Read-only viewers can follow presentations without acquiring edit authority, and world export retains permitted document references and content snapshots.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Bind Yjs documents to reusable notes, whiteboard and annotation surfaces. Implement desktop and qualified XR input, vector strokes, selection and accessible editing views. Anchor annotations to asset revision and page coordinates; send pointers through ephemeral channels while preserving persistent content separately from server-owned presentation control.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise simultaneous edits, page switching, source replacement, disconnected drawing, permission changes, export/reimport and keyboard operation.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce document and surface permissions independently. Bound stroke density and text size, sanitize displayed content and prevent annotations from becoming executable scene behavior.

units.title: Implement authenticated media E2EE keys and membership epochs
externalPrerequisites: A reviewed browser-compatible key-envelope/group-key implementation and security review of endpoint authentication and key lifecycle.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Only admitted endpoints obtain current media keys. Removed devices cannot decrypt future epochs; key loss fails visibly rather than silently disabling encryption. Document that signaling metadata remains server-visible and that revocation cannot erase previously received content.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define the E2EE threat model and implement a reviewed endpoint-authentication and key-envelope protocol around LiveKit's encryption support. Generate session epoch keys at authorized endpoints, distribute encrypted envelopes to verified devices, and rotate on membership changes. Handle late joins, reconnects, key loss, revocation and explicit recovery policy without plaintext keys in service logs. Consume N13 membership/revocation events for device eligibility and key-epoch changes. Scope keys to each actual authorized private media audience rather than sharing one world-wide key.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise device substitution, forged envelopes, late join, removal, reconnect, rotation races and unsupported-browser failure using reviewed protocol fixtures.
sourceMetadata.security: Use established cryptographic primitives and authenticated endpoint identities. Block production E2EE claims until protocol and integration review passes.

units.title: Protect shared content with explicit encrypted-processing boundaries
units.acceptanceCriteria: Authorized clients restore encrypted shared documents and render prepared content after reconnect while storage contains ciphertext. Revoked members cannot obtain new epochs. Choosing server conversion or processing identifies the endpoint's access rather than describing it as outside the trust boundary.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add client-encrypted document updates, snapshots and prepared media/assets using the established key lifecycle and opaque storage/relay contracts. Keep server-required simulation state outside this promise. Provide explicit modes for local preparation or an admitted converter that can read source content; encrypted storage must not silently bypass validation or claim invisible server conversion.
sourceMetadata.tests: Verify encrypted persistence/reload, tampering, wrong keys, large updates, key rotation and conversion-mode transitions with synthetic content.
sourceMetadata.security: Authenticate ciphertext metadata and scope keys to content audiences. Keep client resource limits, provenance and access controls after decryption.

units.title: Record sessions through an explicitly authorized processing endpoint
externalPrerequisites: A deployed recording/egress worker with measured CPU capacity and durable artifact storage.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Recording captures the declared program and produces playable, synchronized output with recoverable failure status. Private sessions cannot gain an undisclosed recorder. The API distinguishes ordinary egress from an E2EE-capable processing path instead of assuming stock egress decrypts arbitrary sessions. A live microphone, a PDF slide change and an uploaded wall video with soundtrack appear once each when selected, at the correct program times; excluded/private sources remain absent.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide recording start/stop/status APIs and a separate recording worker using qualified LiveKit egress or an admitted receiver endpoint. Define captured tracks, surface composition and synchronization metadata. Publish immutable recording artifacts with access and retention hooks. For encrypted sessions, admit a recorder with keys only through explicit application-approved processing policy. Implement a reusable program-composition input contract for live tracks, file-backed audio/video with M12 playback anchors and PDF/slide state. Select a produced mix or a defined listener/viewpoint mix; file-backed sources require content authorization and keys independently of media-track encryption.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise start/stop races, worker crash, missing tracks, key rotation, revoked recorder, retry idempotency and artifact deletion. Exercise the mixed live-track, slide and file-video fixture through capture and playback, checking source selection, timing, audio duplication and separate content/media key access.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize recording separately from listening. Scope processor keys and storage access, and avoid logging decrypted media or reusable credentials.

units.title: Integrate authorized captions and transcription providers
externalPrerequisites: A selected and licensed self-hosted speech-recognition runtime/model or configured transcription provider, plus representative language fixtures.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Captions track the selected audio program and remain aligned through source changes. Encrypted sessions identify the processor as a key-holding endpoint or disable processing clearly. Users can distinguish partial corrections and unavailable transcription from finalized text.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define a transcription provider contract and an explicitly admitted caption-processing endpoint. Route authorized audio, emit speaker/source identifiers and timestamped partial/final captions, and render readable captions in desktop, 2D and qualified XR surfaces. Expose transcript export, access and retention hooks while keeping application language and recording policy separate. Consume the M18 program-input contract, including selected file-backed audio; possession of media-track keys does not grant document or file access.
sourceMetadata.tests: Use known speech fixtures, interruption, mixed sources, caption revisions, provider failure and key revocation; measure latency and documented recognition limits.
sourceMetadata.security: Grant only necessary tracks and keys. Protect transcript artifacts as content, with tenant-scoped access and configurable deletion.

units.title: Relay a shared stage program across independent audience rooms
externalPrerequisites: Relay/republishing capacity and multi-room SFU infrastructure with routable media connectivity for load qualification.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Clients in different audience rooms receive the same live program through real media delivery, not merely matching identifiers. One audience-room failure does not stop the stage. Capacity evidence separates stage publishers, relay fanout, per-room limits and aggregate attendance.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement a generic stage-program source with a common clock, track/source identifiers and an actual authorized relay or republishing worker into independent audience media rooms. Propagate presentation state with measured relay delay, reconnect and source replacement behavior. Keep audience world instances separate and expose topology controls for applications. Reuse the M18 program-input contract to coordinate live tracks, authorized file-backed video/audio timelines and slide state across audience rooms.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise multiple rooms, relay interruption, publisher replacement, clock alignment, room churn and encrypted-mode key rotation under measured traffic.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize each relay destination and its source access. Any relay that decrypts content is an admitted processing endpoint, with explicit keys and trust.

units.title: Deliver a produced broadcast with viewer-latency awareness
externalPrerequisites: A selected broadcast packaging path and CDN/object store supporting required access controls, media formats and CORS.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Many receiver instances share a program without joining one unbounded interactive room. Late joins and buffering preserve the declared synchronization model. The API exposes latency and live-edge status rather than presenting delayed viewers as identical to stage participants.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add a produced-program broadcast adapter with qualified segmented video delivery, authenticated manifests and CDN/object-storage configuration. Map viewer playback time to the stage program clock so slides, annotations and application interactions can account for broadcast delay. Support lightweight and world-surface receivers, with spatial screen audio unless explicit amplification is selected.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise buffering, seeking within the allowed window, token expiry, source discontinuity, CDN failure and viewer-time alignment. Verify the microphone, changing PDF and uploaded wall-video soundtrack fixture end to end, with each chosen input captured once and private inputs excluded.
sourceMetadata.security: Protect manifests and segments with scoped access. Document revocation/cache/buffer limits; broadcast distribution does not automatically preserve media E2EE.

units.title: Promote audience participants into live publishing safely
units.acceptanceCriteria: An authorized audience member can join the live stage without hearing a delayed copy of themselves or retaining duplicate program audio. Failed promotion returns to a usable audience state. Demotion revokes publication and restores the appropriate audience clock and subscriptions.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement application-neutral promotion and demotion transactions between audience reception and authorized live publishing. Obtain fresh grants, establish the interactive connection, transfer relevant control leases and switch playback paths with feedback prevention. Provide status and rollback hooks; applications decide who is invited, accepted or returned to the audience.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise accepted/declined invitations, slow permissions, reconnect mid-transition, duplicate requests, source-device failure and simultaneous handoffs.
sourceMetadata.security: Reauthorize at each boundary, expire transfer grants and revoke old capabilities. Audience membership alone cannot acquire microphone or presenter authority.

units.title: Qualify the complete spatial-media graph on real devices
externalPrerequisites: Reference laptops with speakers/headphones, actual supported headsets, external network probes and consented human listeners for perceptual and echo tests.
units.acceptanceCriteria: Spatial behavior, permission enforcement and single-route playback survive reconnect and source replacement. Acoustic quality remains usable under the declared concurrent load. Stage, broadcast, recording and caption results identify their different latency, trust and capacity profiles.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run reproducible end-to-end scenarios combining four-corner music, moving birds, avatar microphones, area waterfalls, looping screens and live presentations. Qualify laptop speakers, headphones and actual headsets through the final graph, including echo cancellation, output-device changes and resume. Publish supported browser/device configurations, source budgets, drift, frame/audio cost and network conditions.
sourceMetadata.tests: Include blind listening checks, instrumented gain fixtures, restricted-network runs, device swaps, processor failure and hostile subscription attempts; retain evidence for release.
sourceMetadata.security: Use consented test participants and synthetic content. Verify no private tracks, plaintext keys or transcript content enter diagnostics.

units.title: Implement video and audio preparation workers
units.acceptanceCriteria: Representative uploaded media plays through the supported browser profiles with the correct duration, channel layout and seek behavior. Invalid input and unavailable codecs produce clear diagnostics rather than silent audio loss.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate pinned FFmpeg workers for metadata probing, browser-playable video/audio variants, thumbnails and loudness metadata. Define supported codec/container profiles, preserve originals and publish immutable derived media through the asset pipeline.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test variable frame rate, silent and multi-channel inputs, corrupt containers, large files, cancellation, retry and resulting browser playback.
sourceMetadata.security: Run untrusted containers under resource/egress limits, audit the actual FFmpeg build and prevent path, playlist or remote-reference escape.

units.title: Implement office document conversion and safe previews
units.acceptanceCriteria: Representative slide decks and documents yield readable page sequences with correct order and useful font/layout diagnostics. Encrypted, corrupt or unsupported inputs have explicit outcomes; embedded macros do not execute.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate a pinned headless office converter for supported presentation/document inputs, PDF/page outputs and thumbnails. Package fonts and record conversion differences; expose original retrieval and desktop sharing for features that static pages cannot preserve.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare reference pages, fonts, images, slide order, failures and cancellation; verify output through the browser PDF renderer when M14 is integrated.
sourceMetadata.security: Isolate office parsing, disable active content and network references, enforce file/page/resource limits and retain private-document access controls.

units.title: Qualify core spatial audio and laptop echo behavior
externalPrerequisites: Reference laptop speakers/headphones and actual supported headsets
units.acceptanceCriteria: Equally calibrated sources have matching distance gains at equal distances; movement changes the mix continuously. Video audio remains screen-attached with one route. Simultaneous conversation and video remain usable without feedback under the declared profile.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run the core four-corner, moving-source, waterfall and wall-video audio scenarios on headphones, laptop speakers and actual supported headsets. Exercise microphone echo cancellation through the final playback graph and record core source/decoder budgets.
sourceMetadata.tests: Measure gain/cutoff behavior and A/V drift; perform listening, device-change, reconnect, permission-denial and headset-resume checks with real output/capture devices.
sourceMetadata.security: Confirm private streams stay inaccessible and diagnostic output contains no audio content or keys; failures remain release blockers for affected profiles.

units.title: Adapt the browser editor shell and scene selection
units.acceptanceCriteria: An imported world exposes stable selectable entities and hierarchy without duplicating renderer-owned objects. Selection stays synchronized between outline and viewport.
