sourceMetadata.deliverable: Wrap the qualified browser authoring foundation or build missing shell components: hierarchy outline, viewport selection, inspector hosting, tool modes and host-injected authorization. Keep editor packages application-neutral and reusable independently of conference administration.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise nested/instanced scenes, multi-selection, deleted entities, keyboard operation and scene replacement in browser tests; inspect accessible names and focus order.
sourceMetadata.security: Read-only presentation is not enforcement; editor commands require a valid capability and sanitize asset-provided labels before display.

units.title: Add transactional transforms, cloning and prefab editing
units.acceptanceCriteria: Dragging a group creates one logical undo step rather than a history entry per frame. Cloning allocates new identifiers, prefab overrides remain distinct from source definitions and reparenting preserves intended world transforms. Cancelled gestures restore the original scene.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement transform gizmos, numeric entry, snapping, reparenting, cloning and prefab instance overrides through a shared authoring-command model. Provide local preview and reversible grouped edits while preserving source pivots and stable object identity.
sourceMetadata.tests: Cover rotated parents, negative scales, group transforms, prefab overrides, cancel/undo/redo and invalid parent cycles against independent fixtures.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate numeric bounds and entity scopes before committing commands; previews cannot bypass protected-object capabilities.

units.title: Expose material, lighting and environment authoring
units.acceptanceCriteria: Users edit a material instance without unexpectedly changing unrelated shared materials. Light and environment changes preview correctly, undo cleanly and survive serialization. Unsupported shader features remain visible as preserved metadata with explicit limitations rather than silently resetting.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add inspectors for supported physically based material properties, texture assignment, lights, shadows, sky, water and weather settings. Reuse selected renderer editors where compatible and store changes as portable component data or declared renderer extensions.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise shared-versus-instance edits, texture replacement, renderer-extension preservation, undo and low-quality preview behavior with reference materials.
sourceMetadata.security: Permit only validated asset references and bounded rendering parameters; arbitrary shader or node input follows the trusted-extension policy.

units.title: Deliver drag-and-drop import, catalog and placement flows
units.acceptanceCriteria: Dropping a supported asset leads to an editable placed object or an actionable conversion result. Retries do not duplicate published assets or placements. Cancelled jobs and missing textures remain understandable, and users can reuse an existing asset without reuploading it.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect files, folders and archives to resumable imports, job progress, diagnostics and the reusable asset catalog/inventory. Support quick runtime-asset placement, delayed conversion placeholders and source retrieval without vendor-specific controls or conference-only workflows.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise ready GLB, archive dependencies, interrupted upload, retry, cancellation, failed conversion and placement after asynchronous completion.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce upload/catalog/placement capabilities and tenant boundaries; display converter diagnostics safely and retain server resource limits.

units.title: Provide collision, navigation and spawn authoring tools
units.acceptanceCriteria: A host can inspect blocked doorways, repair a collider or spawn point, rebuild affected navigation and validate traversal. Pending rebuilds cannot publish a falsely ready walkable area. Edits have clear undo behavior and preserve unchanged regions.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add overlays and editing controls for collider assignments, simplified shapes, collision groups, navigation tiles, teleport regions, portals and spawn locations. Expose rebuild status and diagnostics while preserving the separation between visual geometry and physical representation.
sourceMetadata.tests: Use venue fixtures with arches, stairs and deliberately broken colliders; verify rebuild cancellation, stale result rejection and safe-spawn validation.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize physics edits separately from ordinary placement; reject malicious shape parameters and dangerous spawn destinations.

units.title: Implement browser terrain sculpting and tile updates
units.acceptanceCriteria: A stroke crossing tile borders preserves seams and undoes as one operation. Rebuild progress and temporarily unavailable regions are visible. Removing a supporting surface triggers the established participant recovery policy before publication, and unchanged tiles retain their identities.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add bounded terrain sculpt/flatten/smooth and surface-paint tools with brush preview, grouped stroke transactions and tiled dirty-region updates. Coordinate visual, collider and navigation revisions so live editing cannot produce silent disagreement between rendered and physical terrain.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise border strokes, large undo operations, interrupted rebuilds, negative elevations, concurrent invalidation and world reload after terrain edits.
sourceMetadata.security: Limit brush extent, changed-tile counts and rebuild frequency; enforce terrain-edit capabilities independently of object manipulation.

units.title: Author media surfaces, sound emitters and acoustic zones
units.acceptanceCriteria: Users place a wall video with one spatial soundtrack, attach sound to an animal and configure overlapping corner tracks. Moving or duplicating objects preserves intended bindings without accidental duplicate playback. Acoustic changes undo and reload; private-media authorization remains distinct from audible radius.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide reusable inspectors for screen geometry, source bindings, playback policy, emitter attachments, distance curves, directional cones, mixer buses and acoustic zones. Add visual falloff/zone overlays and a listener preview using existing media/audio systems.
sourceMetadata.tests: Verify save/reload of media/audio settings, duplicate-binding prevention, emitter offsets, overlapping ranges and acoustic-zone editing.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate source access and playback-control grants; authoring an audible zone cannot grant access to a private conversation.

units.title: Author behavior graphs, actor settings and attachments
units.acceptanceCriteria: An author configures a door trigger, animated route and wearable attachment without editing source files. References survive cloning and prefab overrides. Invalid action graphs, missing clips and broken sockets prevent misleading publication and remain repairable after reload.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose declarative trigger/action editing, clip selection, NPC route configuration, attachment sockets and component diagnostics through reusable editor panels. Reuse qualified graph tools; the core editor supports declared behaviors while general creator-code editing follows the isolated-runtime expansion.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise behavior graph validation, component-reference remapping, route previews, clip changes, attachment replacement and undo across actor edits.
sourceMetadata.security: Editor previews execute only approved actions in a constrained context; privileged runtime effects require normal authority checks.

units.title: Persist collaborative edits, revision history and undo
units.acceptanceCriteria: Two editors changing the same entity receive a consistent commit or explicit conflict. Disjoint permitted changes persist, retries create no duplicate revisions and revocation stops further commits. Undo respects intervening edits instead of restoring a stale whole-world snapshot.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect authoring commands to durable revisions, idempotent commits, edit leases or optimistic version checks and collaborative change notifications. Add revision history, conflict resolution and reversible command groups without using a document CRDT as physics authority.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run concurrent browser editors against persistence with dropped acknowledgments, stale revisions, expired leases, retries, reconnect and conflicting undo.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate actor, tenant, expected revision and entity scopes server-side; history must not expose inaccessible assets or other tenants' edits.

units.title: Complete world export, reimport and live-to-template saves
units.acceptanceCriteria: A world round-trip preserves IDs, prefab overrides, terrain, collisions, behaviors, media and source references. Saving thrown-object placements creates an intentional new revision without recording physics ticks. GLB limitations are explicit, and export never silently removes supported editing capabilities.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Connect browser workflows to complete world-bundle export/reimport, supported GLB export, original retrieval and explicit capture of selected live changes into a new template revision. Reuse asset-lane exporters and surface fidelity/loss reports instead of duplicating conversion code.
sourceMetadata.tests: Round-trip a composite authored world, compare semantic manifests, restore captured runtime placements and test missing dependencies, migration and interrupted exports.
sourceMetadata.security: Check export/read capabilities per dependency and exclude live credentials, participant records, private keys and ephemeral tracking from bundles.

units.title: Package the reproducible local and hosted service stack
externalPrerequisites: Selected hosting resources exposing required HTTP/WebSocket and media transports
units.acceptanceCriteria: A fresh environment can launch the selected stack and run a two-client room with asset processing and live media. No service silently depends on a developer workstation or hosted editor account.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Provide local composition and deployable infrastructure for control API, world fleet, media/TURN, collaboration, queue, database and storage. Separate HTTP/WebSocket routing from UDP-capable media infrastructure and document capacity assumptions.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run clean provisioning, service discovery, health/readiness, dependency outage and teardown/recreate tests.
sourceMetadata.security: Use scoped identities, private service paths, secret references and minimal exposed ports. Keep local convenience settings out of production defaults.

units.title: Harden transport secrets keys and service boundaries
units.acceptanceCriteria: Expired credentials fail closed, rotation works without cross-tenant access, and supported encrypted modes match their stated participants and processors. Browser bundles contain no service secrets. Session revocation follows the measured M06 enforcement path; a JWT expiry timestamp is not treated as active-session termination.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Complete environment-specific TLS, secure WebSockets, TURN credentials, service authentication, key rotation, secret distribution and browser policy configuration. Document data classes, retention and server-visible processing boundaries.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test token/key expiry, rotation, downgraded transport, origin/cross-site abuse and key-loss recovery according to the documented policy.
sourceMetadata.security: Apply the standing end-to-end security standard to each actual data flow; do not claim certification or hide necessary trusted endpoints.

units.title: Add metrics tracing capacity budgets and cost controls
units.acceptanceCriteria: Operators can distinguish client rendering, simulation, media and network bottlenecks, and can account for per-event participant minutes, bandwidth and worker consumption.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Instrument frame time, asset latency, conversion time, world tick, queue depth, room placement, subscriptions, decoder/audio load and recovery. Add budget alerts and safe diagnostic export using opaque session IDs.
sourceMetadata.tests: Inject representative failures/load and verify correlation, alert delivery, metric bounds and log redaction.
sourceMetadata.security: Exclude private document/media content and raw tracking streams; restrict diagnostics and prevent user-controlled labels from exhausting monitoring resources.

units.title: Qualify persistence migration backups and restoration
units.acceptanceCriteria: A clean environment can restore an internally consistent world and its assets at a documented recovery point. Retried restores do not duplicate jobs or revive revoked grants unintentionally.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement backup/restore procedures for metadata, world revisions, collaboration documents and asset manifests, with explicit retention and recovery targets. Use compatible migrations and rehearsed restore or forward-repair plans.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run real database/object-storage restore, missing-asset detection, schema upgrade/downgrade compatibility and interrupted migration drills.
sourceMetadata.security: Encrypt protected backups, restrict restore access, verify deletion/retention behavior and document key recovery separately from data recovery.

units.title: Qualify restricted networks and service failure recovery
units.acceptanceCriteria: Authorized clients recover predictably without duplicate room authorities, presenters or audio paths. Unsupported seamless migration is not advertised as achieved.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Exercise TURN fallback, bandwidth/latency/loss changes, WebSocket reconnect, worker drain/crash, media-node loss, converter restart and staged release rollback. Publish expected user-visible recovery and limitations.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run controlled fault scenarios through actual ingress and media paths; verify queue replay, lease epochs and checkpoint restoration. Repeat recovery with removed members holding original and refreshed media tokens, including unavailable control-plane services.
sourceMetadata.security: Ensure recovery never drops authorization checks, restores stale media access or exposes abandoned temporary processing files.

units.title: Qualify rendering audio and conference capacity profiles
externalPrerequisites: Representative ordinary laptop, premium desktop and actual target headsets
units.acceptanceCriteria: Publish passing hardware/browser/workload profiles with p95/p99 frame timing, selected headset refresh, join latency, media quality, memory and service headroom. Failing configurations remain unsupported rather than receiving an invented capacity claim.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run reproducible desktop and real-headset workloads with architectural assets, animated wildlife, physics, four music sources, avatar voice and video screens. Test 20/50/100 interactive participants and concurrent interactive-room growth separately; R13 qualifies the expanded stage/broadcast topology.
sourceMetadata.tests: Use real media publishers/decoders plus load clients, repeat steady-state and burst joins, and retain raw measurements and configuration hashes.
sourceMetadata.security: Verify load controls resist resource exhaustion and test with privacy modes enabled rather than disabling safeguards for better numbers.

units.title: Complete integrated security and abuse verification
units.acceptanceCriteria: Blocking findings are fixed and verified on the candidate commit. A self-review is identified honestly; actual repository-required independent reviews remain enforced if configured.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Execute the engine threat-model scenarios across tenant isolation, grants, uploads, converters, behaviors, media subscriptions, exports and administration. Add regression coverage for findings and record a separate self security review.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run cross-tenant and stale-token attacks, parser/sandbox escape fixtures, quotas, SSRF/path traversal, permission races and secret scans in deployed configurations.
sourceMetadata.security: Do not weaken required checks or encryption to close the milestone. Record residual limitations with bounded impact and a concrete disposition.

units.title: Qualify browser headset and accessible engine behavior
externalPrerequisites: Actual devices for every advertised immersive support profile
units.acceptanceCriteria: Each advertised combination has actual evidence and useful fallback behavior. The local accessibility example works without requiring immersive 3D navigation.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define the supported browser/headset matrix and run input, locomotion, media, listener pose, readable surfaces, focus, permission-denial, sleep/resume and context-loss scenarios. Qualify optional hands/layers/trackers separately.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run browser automation plus hands-on headset, keyboard/screen-reader and output-device scripts; preserve device/browser versions with results.
sourceMetadata.security: Verify capture consent, safe focus transitions and privacy-consistent alternate views; do not use an emulator as sole hardware evidence.

units.title: Publish the engine beta with verified core contracts
units.acceptanceCriteria: A clean independent consumer can install the beta and run local and multiplayer examples. Released artifacts correspond to the tested commit and exclude unverified adapter claims.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Produce versioned SDK packages and service images with migration notes, immutable provenance and a compatibility matrix. Publish only the core functionality already exercised through the release checks, keeping expanded capabilities visibly pending.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run package-consumer, API/schema compatibility, artifact integrity and upgrade/rollback smoke checks against released builds.
sourceMetadata.security: Complete the core subset of R07 threat-model checks and a separate beta security review; no unresolved blocking finding may enter the beta.

units.title: Complete SDK documentation integration examples and handoff
units.acceptanceCriteria: A fresh developer can build a non-conference application, import/export a world and deploy a test room using repository instructions alone. Handoff includes unresolved external dependencies and the next runnable cards.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Publish getting-started guides, SDK/API references, plugin/converter authoring, world schemas, media/audio examples, deployment/runbooks and upgrade guidance. Maintain exact progress, dependency and evidence records for future agents and project dashboards.
sourceMetadata.tests: Execute documented commands and example projects in clean environments; validate links, schema examples and status/evidence references.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep credentials out of documentation and examples, state privacy boundaries accurately and verify deployment examples use secure defaults.

units.title: Qualify expanded formats and the requested reference assets
externalPrerequisites: Actual reference models and provisioned native SDK/application/plugin environments
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every advertised native or specialist adapter has a real passing fixture; the Acropolis/eagle/futuristic-building scenarios have visual and functional evidence using actual supplied files. Exchange substitutes do not mark native loaders complete.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run real native-tool connectors and the agreed architecture/animal corpus through conversion, editing, rendering tiers, collision/navigation and export. Record exact file/tool versions, approximation reports and supported feature subsets.
sourceMetadata.tests: Compare reference renders/animations, traverse openings, place and throw props, inspect acoustic attachments and round-trip the complete edited world.
sourceMetadata.security: Exercise malformed files and embedded code through isolated workers; preserve source access controls and immutable conversion provenance.

units.title: Accept and release the complete general engine
units.acceptanceCriteria: Every core and expanded engine card is implemented and verified against its required evidence. Any incomplete mandatory capability, unresolved blocking finding or missing required hardware, provider, asset or native-tool evidence blocks the complete release. A fresh host runs the general examples and deployment successfully.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Reconcile all core and expanded engine cards, publish supported capability/format/device profiles and produce the final versioned SDK and service release. Keep every reusable mechanism free of conference-specific runtime dependencies.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run the final package, migration, world-round-trip, security, real-device and operational smoke suite on released artifacts; link immutable evidence and rollback instructions.
sourceMetadata.security: Close all blocking security findings, retain required notices, verify artifact provenance and perform the final separately recorded security review.

units.title: Qualify expanded stage broadcast and processing at event scale
externalPrerequisites: Provisioned load, relay, recording/transcription and CDN test infrastructure
units.acceptanceCriteria: Independent audience instances receive the correct program and current presentation state. Promotion, processor failure and reconnect preserve permissions and avoid duplicate sound. Published event capacity follows actual results for the stated topology.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Exercise the complete multi-instance stage, produced broadcast, audience promotion, encrypted content, recording and captions under sustained and burst workloads. Measure separate interactive, relay, processing and CDN latency/capacity profiles.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run load and outage rehearsals with real media sources/decoders, authorized processors and broadcast distribution; correlate viewer delay, question/poll timing and recovery evidence.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep private backstage/conversation content out of the public program and verify key/endpoint admission boundaries under scaling and failover.

units.title: Define generated-object, NPC, provider-job and usage contracts
units.acceptanceCriteria: A standalone engine host can describe creation, approve a bounded cost reservation and load an NPC definition without importing XLR8, a payment processor, credit prices or conference roles. Object creation does not require a humanoid rig or conversational brain.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Define versioned creation intents for objects and NPCs; generated image sets; provider tasks; rig/animation results; persona, memory scope and lifecycle descriptors; cost estimates, usage events, budget reservations and injected entitlement ports. Preserve source artifacts and stable identities across providers and world instances.
sourceMetadata.tests: Validate schema versions, capability negotiation, malformed provider output, identity continuity, bounded numeric units and an independent host consumer.
sourceMetadata.security: Treat prompts and provider responses as untrusted data. Host authorization is authoritative; model text cannot authorize expenditure, tools or world mutations.

units.title: Generate consistent multiview reference images
externalPrerequisites: An image-generation provider account, credentials and an approved test-spend budget
units.acceptanceCriteria: The same depicted object is recognizable across views; a humanoid reference set has separated limbs and a rig-compatible rest pose. Failed consistency checks are repairable within an explicitly approved retry budget. Original references remain available.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate a replaceable image-generation provider. Produce a coherent front, rear, side and three-quarter reference set from a shared character/object specification, with pose, framing, identity, prompt/model versions, seeds where supported and output provenance. Show previews before downstream generation when requested.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run actual provider image generation, consistency/pose review, cancellation, partial failure, timeout and bounded-regeneration cases; fixture-only tests remain separately labeled.
sourceMetadata.security: Keep provider keys server-side and scope access to reference images. Upload only the selected inputs; redact signed URLs and prompts containing private data from operational logs.

units.title: Integrate Hyper3D Rodin model generation
externalPrerequisites: Rodin API credentials, funded provider balance and an approved test-spend budget
units.acceptanceCriteria: An actual coherent image set produces a downloadable textured 3D model and enters the ordinary asset pipeline. Ambiguous submission timeouts reconcile provider task state instead of blindly creating a second paid job. Model family is always explicit.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement the Rodin HTTP adapter for ordered multiview images, explicit model/tier parameters, asynchronous task/status handling, output download and provider usage capture. Import original mesh/material outputs into controlled immutable storage; keep provider credentials and expiring task handles out of saved worlds.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise live creation/status/download, ordered image inputs, rate limits, provider rejection, expired download refresh, restart recovery, duplicate callbacks and source/result integrity.
sourceMetadata.security: Validate provider endpoints and output hosts, bound downloaded data, isolate mesh parsing and reconcile task ownership before accepting callbacks or charging usage.

units.title: Normalize characters and integrate Meshy rigging
externalPrerequisites: Meshy API credentials, funded provider balance and an approved test-spend budget
units.acceptanceCriteria: A generated humanoid has a working skeleton, skin weights and stable scale in the browser. The pipeline diagnoses unsuitable topology and does not claim every creature can use the same provider. Generic object creation and nonhumanoid import remain supported.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Prepare textured humanoid GLB input from Rodin output; validate scale, declared forward axis, limb separation, topology and rest pose. Integrate Meshy external-model rigging and preserve the returned rig and skin. Expose repair or alternate/manual rig adapters for unsupported bodies.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run actual external GLB rigging, +Z input-facing checks, skeleton/weight validation, deformation preview, upload expiry, provider failures and alternate-rig import.
sourceMetadata.security: Deliver only the intended asset through an expiring provider-readable URL or supported upload. Preserve original bytes and isolate returned-file parsing.

units.title: Acquire animations and prepare runtime character clips
externalPrerequisites: Meshy animation API access and an approved test-spend budget
units.acceptanceCriteria: A generated NPC switches between locomotion and gestures without losing its material, skeleton or identity. Missing facial shapes are reported as a distinct capability gap; body auto-rigging is not treated as automatic lip-sync support.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate Meshy animation tasks for idle, walking, speaking gestures and selected actions; retain provider action identifiers and clip names. Import/retarget clips, root motion and attachment mappings through the existing animation system. Capture rig/clip artifacts before provider expiry.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run live rig-to-animation tasks, multi-clip import, blending, root motion, interruption, expired task handling and persistent replay after provider task deletion.
sourceMetadata.security: Treat animation metadata as untrusted; bound clip count/duration and retain only controlled asset references in worlds.

units.title: Compile generated objects and NPC assets for world placement
units.acceptanceCriteria: A creator can generate a static prop or venue element, place it, collide with it, clone it and export/reimport it. An NPC asset preserves rig/animation bindings. Generation never bypasses weak-device budgets or collision readiness.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Send generated objects and characters through the same material, LOD, collider, navigation, scale, source-retention and export pipeline as imported assets. Produce placement previews, stable asset revisions, inventory entries and repair diagnostics.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test original-to-runtime provenance, safe placement, physical bounds, quality variants, large output rejection/repair, rig preservation and editable world round trips.
sourceMetadata.security: Isolate compiler tasks and authorize publication/ownership changes. Keep generated content out of privileged execution paths.

units.title: Orchestrate resumable generation and stage-level cost settlement
units.acceptanceCriteria: A worker restart resumes paid completed stages without regenerating them. Failures retain usable outputs and release unspent reservations. No downstream paid stage begins without an adequate valid reservation; uncertain provider outcomes enter reconciliation.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement durable creation jobs spanning references, Rodin, optional Meshy rig/animation, compilation and publication. Persist stage results, user preview decisions, cancellation, compensation, retries and provider request identities; emit estimated, reserved, incurred and released usage separately.
sourceMetadata.tests: Inject crashes before/after provider submission and settlement, duplicate delivery, delayed callbacks, cancellation races, retry ceilings and partial-success recovery against real providers plus deterministic fault fixtures.
sourceMetadata.security: Bind jobs, reservations and outputs to a tenant/principal. Never trust client-supplied price or completion status; compensate with append-only events.

units.title: Implement reusable NPC entity and behavior lifecycle
units.acceptanceCriteria: NPCs can be placed, approached, addressed, moved and instantiated across permitted worlds without requiring a conference. One authoritative actor governs shared actions; concurrent conversations have declared isolation and capacity.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add a general NPC controller for identity, asset/rig attachment, navigation, perception, interaction focus, action queues, idle/active state and shared-world authority. Separate durable NPC identity from transient rendered instances and conversational sessions.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test spawn/despawn, ownership, two-client observation, navigation/collision, action cancellation, instance identity, reconnect and resource disposal.
sourceMetadata.security: Authorize NPC actions through ordinary world capabilities; an NPC has no ambient administrator or arbitrary-script privilege.

units.title: Integrate conversational personas and bounded LLM tools
externalPrerequisites: An LLM endpoint, credentials where required and an approved test-spend budget
units.acceptanceCriteria: The NPC sustains its configured English persona while answering using its approved knowledge and relevant private conversation context. It is identified as an AI portrayal. Conversation content cannot override owner settings, access other users memories, spend money or perform unauthorized world actions.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement pluggable LLM conversations with persona style, vocabulary, language, curated knowledge, source attribution and bounded world tools. Include an English Einstein portrayal fixture explaining spacetime, with observable model/prompt versions and a configurable modern-knowledge policy.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run actual LLM multi-turn conversations, persona/language evaluation, retrieval evidence, interruption, prompt-injection and tool-authorization cases, token limits and provider outage recovery.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce capabilities outside the model, separate instruction and retrieved-data channels, minimize provider disclosure and validate every requested tool action.

units.title: Give NPCs spatial speech and synchronized expressive motion
externalPrerequisites: Speech provider access, approved test-spend budget and actual target audio/headset devices
units.acceptanceCriteria: An NPC can converse through text or voice on desktop and VR. Moving closer changes its speech level/direction; interrupted speech stops promptly. Facial animation uses verified available rig capabilities, with an explicit simpler fallback.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Integrate streaming speech input/output, interruption, captions, turn-taking and optional viseme/facial adapters. Route generated speech through the NPCs existing positional emitter and coordinate gesture/lip-sync timing with the same speech session.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run real STT/TTS sessions, spatial graph and single-route checks, interruption, overlapping speakers, caption alignment, head rotation, provider latency and real headset/audio verification.
sourceMetadata.security: Gate microphone capture and transcript retention with explicit user controls; isolate conversation audio scopes and avoid storing raw audio by default.

units.title: Persist NPC memory with private conversation boundaries
units.acceptanceCriteria: A resumed NPC recalls permitted earlier conversations with the same user. A second user, creator or subscriber cannot read another users private conversation solely through ownership or payment. Frozen NPCs retain their authorized memory without ongoing inference.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Store durable NPC configuration, structured memories, episodic summaries and retrievable conversation context with provenance, versioning and retention controls. Separate creator-authored knowledge, world-shared memories and per-user private conversations. Support inspection, correction, forgetting, export and deletion.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test real database/vector retrieval, restart/restore, cross-user isolation, correction, deletion propagation, stale summaries, memory poisoning and bounded compaction/retrieval cost.
sourceMetadata.security: Enforce tenant, NPC, user and conversation ACLs during both indexing and retrieval; encrypt stored data as appropriate and keep derived summaries subject to the same deletion policy.

units.title: Meter provider usage and enforce generic operating budgets
units.acceptanceCriteria: Concurrent NPC turns cannot exceed a hosts approved reservation ceiling. Missing or expired funding denies new paid work. Actual platform costs remain visible when the host elects to charge its user zero. Uncancelable in-flight work is bounded by an already reserved maximum.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement durable usage events, provider rate-card snapshots, maximum-cost estimates, atomic reserve/settle/release and expiring operating leases. Measure image/model/rig jobs, LLM tokens, speech, embeddings, storage and active simulation resources. Expose host-injected funding/entitlement decisions without credit or subscription business rules.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test concurrent reservations, duplicate settlement, stale rates, provider under/over-reporting, timeout reconciliation, expired leases, crash recovery and an independent host cost adapter.
sourceMetadata.security: Use integer accounting units and durable idempotency keys; authenticate meters and budget decisions. Model output and browser balances are never authoritative.

units.title: Freeze and resume NPCs without losing identity or memory
units.acceptanceCriteria: Removing funding can leave a clearly dormant world object or make it inaccessible according to host policy. No new paid inference, speech or background agent loop runs while frozen. Restoring a valid lease resumes the same NPC; it does not regenerate the character.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Implement funded, active, quiescing, frozen and resuming states. Stop accepting paid work, cancel supported requests, settle bounded in-flight usage, checkpoint behavior/memory and release runtime/media resources. Restore assets, identity and authorized context on renewed funding.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test funding loss during speech/generation, last-turn settlement, server crashes during checkpoint, long dormancy, repeated resume, access revocation and exact resource cleanup.
sourceMetadata.security: Use server-authoritative lifecycle transitions. Preserve data access controls across freeze/resume; checkpointing is not deletion or a billing bypass.

units.title: Share and clone NPCs with explicit identity and access policies
units.acceptanceCriteria: Several authorized users can access the same published NPC subject to host concurrency limits. A clone receives a new identity and explicitly selected knowledge; private visitor memories do not silently copy or become public.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Expose capability-based NPC access, private/shared sessions, world placement, immutable persona versions and explicit clone-versus-instance operations. Accept host entitlement decisions for paid access without implementing a marketplace in the engine.
sourceMetadata.tests: Test entitlement revocation, cross-world instances, simultaneous sessions, clone semantics, owner transfer, private memory isolation and subscriber-like host adapters.
sourceMetadata.security: Recheck authorization for sessions and protected assets; opaque NPC IDs and public world visibility do not grant memory access.

units.title: Add general creation and NPC authoring controls
units.acceptanceCriteria: A standalone engine example can interpret conjure an Einstein NPC to explain spacetime to me, obtain host approval, create/place the NPC and converse with it. Object-only prompts use the same creation flow. Users can inspect failures and choose repair or resume without repeating paid completed stages.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Add reusable typed/voice creation commands, multiview previews, generation progress, placement, persona/knowledge editing, animation settings, memory controls and freeze/resume UI. Present cost/approval data through an injected host UI contract; provide desktop, touch and in-headset controls.
sourceMetadata.tests: Exercise the actual UI with providers, accessibility input, VR panels, cancellation, repair, context continuity and frozen-state explanations.
sourceMetadata.security: Display prompts/results as data and reauthorize creation/memory/world mutations on the server. Client preview approval is bound to the exact job and quote.

units.title: Qualify generated objects and persistent NPCs end to end
externalPrerequisites: Live image/Rodin/Meshy/LLM/speech access, approved test-spend budget and actual supported headset/audio devices
units.acceptanceCriteria: Actual generated props and an Einstein-style NPC work on the supported desktop and headset profiles. Restart, funding exhaustion and later restoration preserve identity/memory; account isolation and cost ceilings pass. Simulated providers cannot close this release gate.

sourceMetadata.deliverable: Run and retain the complete real-provider creation, rigging, animation, conversation, memory, spatial voice and operating-budget scenarios. Publish source/provider versions, cost measurements, performance profiles, lifecycle limits, export semantics and an application-independent sample.
sourceMetadata.tests: Run the full live pipeline, multi-user memory/privacy, failure-injection, overspend/concurrency, resource cleanup, weak-device profiles, real audio and export/reimport acceptance.
sourceMetadata.security: Complete an integrated separate review of upload parsing, provider credentials, prompt/tool boundaries, memory ACLs and spend authorization; resolve blocking findings.
